snippet.title: Other Tower Release Trailer (CYOP Tower feat. Golf 2 and Po-Boy Bayou)
snippet.description:
Check out the tower on Game Banana, or download it through the CYOP level browser!
https://gamebanana.com/mods/446545

Next to the legendary Pizza Tower stands another tower, an "Other" tower of sorts. Full of strange places unfamiliar to pizza kind and uncomfortable familiar faces, are you ready to get funky again in the name of Peppino's Pizza?

Featuring 2 Levels, Golf 2 and Po-Boy Bayou, with more on the way!

Custom music and art done by Samwow, with playtesting help from Tidal and Green Guy.

Po-Boy Bayou P Rank footage by @NotHackstr 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wlHmWh_put0&ab_channel=Samwow
